name: Meadhbh
text: Meadhbh and Méadhbh are Modern Irish spellings of Medb, the warrior-queen of Connacht. The dictionary treats the name only inside the Medb article.

attributes.attribute: variant spelling of the Connacht warrior-queen's name

okr.objective: Documents Meadhbh as recorded in MacKillop 2008 for the Public Celtic Encyclopedia.
key_results: Meadhbh and Méadhbh stand as Modern Irish spellings of Medb.
All substance on this figure lives in the Medb entry.
